passwordReset.requestIntro: Enter the email address you log in with. If it belongs to an account, you'll get an email with a link to choose a new password.
passwordReset.requestSent: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
passwordReset.invalidLink: This password reset link is invalid or has expired.
passwordReset.rateLimited_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
passwordReset.rateLimited_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
passwordReset.success: Your password has been reset. Log in with your new password.

emailVerification.title: Verify your email

emailVerification.logInToResend: Log in to request a new verification link.
emailVerification.rateLimited_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
emailVerification.rateLimited_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
emailVerification.resendSent: If your email address still needs verification, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
emailVerification.notVerifiedHint: Open the link in the verification email we sent to this address, or send a new one.
emailVerification.changeEmailDescription: Enter your new email address. We'll send a verification link to it, and your address stays unverified until you open that link.
